text:
Jordan: Quick flag — Q2 renewal with HelixCare (acct HC-948). They asked for a concise SLA evidence pack for uptime & p50/p95 latency covering the onboarding window. Can ops/sre pull a bundle by EOD?

Sam: On it. Which metrics window do you want? 30 days or since go-live?

Jordan: Customer wants 30-day window + onboarding week. They'll escalate renewal if credits exceed ~1% of committed usage.

Devin: FYI sales needs a one-page summary they can attach to the renewal deck. 1 slide max.

Alex: I can generate p50/p95 per-route from trace logs. Need the route names — I think it's /api/generate and /api/embed, right?

Priya: I'll export uptime (percent) and incident list for 2026-02-01..2026-03-31 and include a latency heatmap.

Sam: I'll assemble the credits calc when I have commit numbers. @billing-bot can you confirm HelixCare's commit?

billing-bot: HelixCare commit: 2,000,000 tokens/month. Billing window: 2026-02-01 to 2026-04-30.

Sam: Thanks — running estimated credit exposure now.

Jordan: Also please capture enablement activity: number of onboarding sessions, support tickets opened, playbooks shared. They care about proactive enablement as part of health.

Devin: I have onboarding session dates (2026-02-10, 2026-02-17). I'll drop the attendee list and slide deck.

Alex: Pasting quick snippet I'll run to generate per-route latency exports:
```
python tools/latency_export.py --routes "/api/generate","/api/embed" --start 2026-02-01 --end 2026-03-31 --percentiles 50,95 > helix_latency.tsv
```

Sam: Once we have numbers I'll draft the credits table. Need to show calculation logic: downtime windows, affected requests, commit baseline, resulting credit %. Keep it simple and reproducible.

Priya: Uploading artifacts to the CS evidence folder, link: https://drive.redwood.internal/cs/helixcare/q2-sla-evidence (will add files as I export).

Jordan: Goal — deliver to customer by 2026-04-05. Include a 1-page summary + appendix with raw exports and reproducible commands.

Alex: Heads up — one incident on 2026-03-15 03:21 UTC had elevated p95 due to KV cache eviction after a deploy. I'll add a short root-cause note and mitigation steps.

Sam: Action items:
- Alex: latency export + RC note
- Priya: uptime %, incident list, latency heatmap
- Devin: onboarding notes + one-pager slide
- billing-bot: commit confirmation (received)
- Jordan: assemble final pack and send to customer

Jordan: I'll coordinate a quick review with legal if we mention credits. Who can review the final pack?

Devin: I can review the slide content.

Alex: I'll review the technical appendix.

Priya: I'll sanity-check uptime math and the incident timestamps.

Jordan: Thanks team :pray: If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.

Sam: Noted — I'll post the preliminary credits table in this thread when ready.

billing-bot: Uploaded invoice and commit artifact to the drive link.

Jordan: Excellent — once Sam posts the calc I’ll draft the customer note w/ one-pager and send for internal review.

Sam: ETA for calc: 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC.

Jordan: Great. Closing loop here — will follow up with a DM if anything slips.
